<div class="card-body">
'''Image Of The Dark Lord''' is a [[Dark]] [[Effect]] from [[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">暗黒卿の肖像</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">相手が自分より3フォース以上多くフォースを発生させている時に4フォース消費して任意の位置に配備する。その位置と隣接位置では、そこに人員を持っていないプレイヤーはフォースを発生させることができない。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Image-Of-The-Dark-Lord-PSA-84363908.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">ベイダーのホログラムは彼の軍団に絶対の忠誠を誓わせる。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Image Of The Dark Lord.

'''Card text:'''
When the opponent is generating at least 3 Force more than you, spend 4 Force to deploy at any location. At that location and adjacent locations, a player with no presence there cannot generate Force.

'''Lore:'''
Vader’s hologram exacts absolute loyalty from his legions.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese face names only that location and adjacent locations.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Image Of The Dark Lord]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
